mainEntity.name: Which LODs do you model to?

acceptedAnswer.text: LOD 200–400 as specified in your BEP. Higher LODs are confirmed per project scope.

mainEntity.name: What clash outputs do you provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grouped clash reports, viewpoints and issue logs in your preferred format.
Workflows can be aligned to ISO 19650 information management principles. ENGISOFT does not claim formal certification unless independently verified.

mainEntity.name: What scan formats do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common formats such as E57, RCP/RCS and LAS/LAZ, subject to file size and registration quality.
Drawing standards follow your project requirements and the relevant authority submission rules.
Yes. Rebar Detailing covers bar bending schedules and reinforcement drawings.
BIM modelling is not engineering design sign-off. Calculation responsibilities remain with the engineer of record unless contracted otherwise.

mainEntity.name: Can infrastructure and building models be federated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, via Navisworks/IFC federation with agreed coordinate systems.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle consultant comment cycles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Comment resolution is part of the drawing workflow; cycles are scoped per project.

mainEntity.name: Which codes do you detail to?

acceptedAnswer.text: As specified by the structural engineer of record on the project.

mainEntity.name: Can you work from design-intent drawings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Design-intent information is developed into approval and fabrication drawings.

mainEntity.name: What does an audit report contain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Findings by severity, evidence views, and recommended fixes against the agreed checklist.

mainEntity.name: Can you prepare a BEP for a tender?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A pre-appointment BEP can be prepared for the bid and developed into the post-appointment BEP once the team is confirmed.

mainEntity.name: What do we receive after each clash run?

acceptedAnswer.text: A clash report grouped by zone and trade, with viewpoints, responsible party and status, ready for the coordination meeting.
2D CAD drawings, PDFs, product sheets or precise dimensions, plus the parameters and Revit version you work in.

mainEntity.name: What if the CAD drawings disagree with each other?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conflicts between drawings are logged with views and raised as queries before they are modelled, so nothing is guessed silently.
